description: One-off move of every event without a seat ledger onto it: empty ledgers for cancelled or empty active events, demo seat records for synthetic bookings, and the paged migration engine for active events, then bookedCount set to the ledger occupied seats.
reason: Nothing left to migrate. On 22 Nov 2026 the owner applied it to catch-dating-app-64e51 and it was applied to catchdates-dev; a final dry run in each project reported every event on-ledger (28 prod, 147 dev). Events are born with a ledger since PR #2342, and the one-seat-path change removes the migration engine the tool drove, so it can no longer run.
